references.text: A birth under special circumstances is also mentioned here, which can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' birth in a stable and placement in a manger.
The prophecy of a virgin birth points forward to Jesus' unique birth, as described in Luke 2:12.
Matthew refers to Isaiah's prophecy about the virgin birth, which is part of the context surrounding Jesus' birth.
This verse speaks of Jesus entering the world in a humble way, which can be seen in light of his humble birth and placement in a manger.
